quest.title: Help Mr. Page get his space books

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Hello again! I am so glad you came <color=red>back</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Everyone wants to read about the stars and the <color=red>planets</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: They took all my space books. My shelves are <color=red>empty</color> again!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Barnaby, Tilly and Gus need help today. Please go and <color=red>visit</color> them.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Help all three. Then my books will zoom home like a <color=red>rocket</color>!

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Help Barnaby, Tilly and Gus. Then come and <color=red>tell</color> me!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Wow! My shelves are <color=red>full</color> of space books!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: You helped Barnaby, Tilly and Gus. You are a <color=red>star</color>!

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: My space books are home. Come and read about the <color=red>stars</color> any time!
